brief_summary: This study will investigate the non-growth-hormone-dependent metabolic effects of the hormone Ghrelin in growth hormone deficient subjects by examining the insulin tolerance as well as signal proteins in fat and muscle biopsies.
brief_title: The Effect of Pharmacological Antilipolysis on the Metabolic Effects of Ghrelin

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* males with hypopituitarism in regard to growth hormone and ACTH in stabile treatment regime
* age 18-65
* BMI 20-35

Exclusion Criteria:

* abuse of alcohol
* malign disease
* medication other than that expected for hypopituitarism
* known disease other than hypopituitarism
* participation in isotope investigations the last 6 months

official_title: The Effect of Pharmacological Antilipolysis on the Metabolic Effects of Ghrelin

primary_outcomes.measure: Effects of ghrelin during basal and hyperinsulinemic conditions
